How much interest would the refinanced loan charge in its first month, at 7.6% a year?
How much lower is the monthly payment under the refinance?
How many months of the monthly saving does it take to recover the $625 in fees? Give one decimal place.
What is the total of payments under the current loan?
What is the total of payments under the refinance?
What is the net saving from refinancing across the full 42 months, after the $625 in fees?
Cornelius expects to repay the loan early, in about 18 months. Do the $625 of fees get recovered out of the monthly payment saving by then?
